title: Zoetrope
pitch: The level is the inside of a spinning zoetrope drum: build momentum across laps to wake the sepia world into living color, and lap enemies to strike them from behind.
howto: Keep running — uninterrupted speed builds momentum tiers that saturate the painted drum and phase in foes, hazards and richer pickups. Outrun an enemy a full lap and strike its back for a backstab. Bank cogs and spend them on momentum gear between runs.
controls: Left/right to run, JUMP and STRIKE buttons. Keyboard: A/D + Space + J. Gamepad: stick + A jump + X strike.
